title: Ukraine Resumes Drone Strikes on Ryazan and Saratov Refineries After Brief Energy Truce
detail: Russian Deputy PM Aleksandr Novak said refineries in the Ryazan and Saratov regions were targeted by drones on Wednesday, after a short Trump-backed energy truce. Russia's Defense Ministry reported downing 69 drones and four Flamingo cruise missiles; the Ryazan governor reported a fire and no casualties. Kremlin spokesman Peskov said Ukraine never stopped refinery strikes. Date and details rest on a single search-derived report and need corroboration.

media.caption: Ukraine resumes attacks on Russian oil refineries
